summary: A food-themed specimen in a three-colour riso palette (butter yellow, mint, lavender): chapters named like a menu (Landscapes, Ingredients, Recipe, Cherry on the Cake, Cashier, Pure Pleasure) over duotone photographs. The 'Recipe' chapter's article text is itself the tester, with swash, caps and italic switches per paragraph.

instances.look: Slim butter-yellow top bar that slides in after the hero: 'Basco → LANDSCAPES' naming the current chapter, cart icon right; offscreen in the DOM and stitched repeatedly into crops 01-06
Butter-yellow screen with a cut-out mint-duotone photo of a citrus drink and fruit at left; 'Basco' in heavy lavender, swash-italic tagline and a small style note right-aligned
instances.feel: Printed menu from a beach bar
instances.ux: A 'Basco…' loader fattens from Thin to Bold for ~4s, then the hero fades in
instances.learn: One duotone cut-out in the palette's second colour on a flat field gives a whole theme with no type effects

reconstruction.layout: 100vh, 1440×900; image left ~50% wide bleeding toward the bottom; right-aligned text block ending at x≈1380: name at y≈110, tagline, note
reconstruction.typography: Name ~200px Basco Bold/Heavy; tagline 48px Basco Italic swash, leading ~1.2, right-aligned; note ~22px Regular
reconstruction.behaviour: Loader: 'Basco…' centred, stepping through the weights over ~4s; then cross-fade
reconstruction.content: 'A mix of Renaissance & Calligraphy, with a touch of tropical atmosphere'; 'Nine weights in Romans & Italics, swashes'

instances.look: Lavender duotone waterfall photo under paired Portuguese words: two columns of word pairs, alternating white and mint, Roman and swash italic, then capitals
instances.ux: Words fade in as the section scrolls; the storyboard shows them nearly invisible on entry
instances.learn: Two-word rows mixing weights and two colours keep a stack dense, and Portuguese words sell the designer's Brazilian voice

reconstruction.layout: 1760px section, ten centred rows of two words, ~150px per row, ~1200px wide
reconstruction.typography: ~110px Basco, Thin to Black; alternating Roman/Italic with swashes (swsh, dlig 'st', 'sp'); last rows caps
reconstruction.behaviour: GSAP fade-in of the rows as they enter; background photo stays fixed in colour
reconstruction.content: Quadruplas, Maracanã, Respectiva, Qüinqüênio, Magistério, Nespereira, Horizonte, Hedonistas, PANTHERA, PARAGUAY
reconstruction.assets: Lavender duotone waterfall photo, ten images overall

instances.look: 'Ingredients': centred running lines of the set over a mint duotone spice shop; lowercase, italics, small caps, capitals, swash forms, ligatures, figures, circled numerals, superiors, math, arrows, marks; top row of pointing-hand dingbats
instances.feel: An inventory on a market shelf
instances.learn: Naming the set 'ingredients' and listing it in centred lines keeps the glyph table inside the page's metaphor

reconstruction.layout: Centred lines, 1200-1300px wide; each category has its line with ~90px line pitch over a fixed-feeling image; dingbat row across the top, ~90px tall
reconstruction.typography: ~60px Basco Regular per line, italics and swashes per category, small accents row ~24px
reconstruction.content: Character set by category with no labels

instances.look: End of the Ingredients section on flat mint: ROMANS and ITALICS columns of style names in themselves, light in yellow-white, bold in butter
instances.learn: Split nine weights into a light and a bold column so a two-axis list fits in one row of four columns

reconstruction.typography: ~60px, each name in its own style; column heads in small caps
reconstruction.content: Thin, ExtraLight, Light, Regular, Demi, Bold, ExtraBold, Heavy, Black

instances.look: 'Cherry on the cake': the swash capitals A-Z scattered at varied sizes and weights over lavender duotone spices, in yellow and pale grey, overlapping
instances.ux: The letters seem to drift in layers as you scroll; the doubled letters in the crop are the same letters caught mid-motion
instances.learn: Treat decorative capitals as confetti: scatter, vary weight and size, and let them overlap

reconstruction.layout: 1558px section; about 26 absolutely placed letters in a loose 5×5 scatter, each ~120-300px
reconstruction.typography: Basco Italic swash capitals, Thin to Black
reconstruction.behaviour: Assumed GSAP parallax per letter on scroll (speed from the differing offsets between stitched viewports)

instances.look: 'Recipe' article on flat mint: four text blocks at 144, ~48, 28 and 36px, the first with a small 'TT / I / A' tab on a rule for caps, italic and swash; ampersands in SVG open the section
instances.feel: The article waits for a click
instances.ux: Each paragraph is contenteditable and has its own caps, italic and swash toggles, shown when active; the rest of the page stays intact
instances.learn: Turn the About copy into the tester: three style toggles per paragraph make the swash system discoverable without a separate tool

reconstruction.layout: 4009px section, content column 1200px from x=120; ampersand SVGs top-left ~580px tall; each .tester has text plus a rule with the toggle tab at left
reconstruction.typography: h1 144px Medium swash, leading ~1.15; h2 48px Italic swash caps; p.small 28px Regular leading 1.45; p 36px Italic swash, leading 1.55
reconstruction.behaviour: Click a <li> to toggle caps, italic or swsh classes on the sibling text; two-way class state; fonts stay on the same size
reconstruction.content: Real article on the Renaissance sources and Bruno Mello's approach

instances.look: Four graded paragraphs explaining Renaissance calligraphy as the source, then features and the designer, each in another text style
instances.ux: Reads as an essay; every paragraph can be restyled in place
instances.learn: Grade the same story through four sizes and styles so the text works as hierarchy demo too

reconstruction.typography: As the tester: 144px, 48px caps italic, 28px Regular, 36px italic
reconstruction.content: 'Basco is an exploration of the Renaissance style…'; 'Basco is the first typeface by Sao Paulo based designer Bruno Mello…'

instances.look: 'Cashier': yellow screen with a teal duotone dog in profile, a right-aligned credit in swash italic and three small tracked mint text links
instances.feel: A closing joke rather than a sales pitch
instances.ux: Three links to Typofonderie: buy, try-out fonts, PDF specimen
instances.learn: Mirror the hero layout for the buy section: same palette, new animal, and links small enough to stay elegant

reconstruction.layout: 100vh-ish 933px; dog bust from the left edge, ~500px tall; right column right-aligned at x≈1320, links at the bottom right
reconstruction.typography: Credit ~80px Basco Italic swash; note ~22px; links ysans-std ~13px caps, tracked
reconstruction.content: 'Basco, a contemporary take on calligraphic letterforms by Bruno Mello'; 'Buy Basco', 'Free try-out fonts', 'Download the PDF specimen'

instances.look: 'Pure pleasure': full-width justified lines of food words over a mauve duotone of blueberries, each with its own size and style and fit to the column
instances.feel: A chalkboard menu at full volume
instances.learn: Fit each line to the same measure by changing the size, and the page becomes one big typographic menu

reconstruction.layout: 2359px section, ~1300px measure, 14 centred lines of varying height 60-200px
reconstruction.typography: 60-300px Basco, Thin to Black, Roman/Italic/swash, caps and lowercase, alternating yellow, white and mint
reconstruction.behaviour: Rows fade in with GSAP on scroll
reconstruction.content: Cookies, Pasta Ai Fiori Di Zucca, Meringue Cheesecake, Roasted Vegetables, Trustworthy, Fajita, Homemade stracciatella, Chunky, Easy Chorizo Tacos, Brazilian Chicken, Respectable Guacamole

instances.look: Dark grey band: Typofonderie logo left, list of chapters in small caps, then credits
instances.learn: List the chapters again in the footer as a table of contents
